name: 020_contradiction_chain
description: A fact is updated twice in chain — only the final value should be active.

episodes.text:
User: My target is to study for 30 minutes each day.
Assistant: A reasonable start.

User: I've increased my study target to 1 hour a day.
Assistant: Good ambition.

User: I'm now committing to 2 hours of study every day — I have a deadline.
Assistant: Intensive but achievable.

planted_facts: User studies for 2 hours every day
absent_facts: User studies for 30 minutes each day
User studies for 1 hour a day

contradictions.a: User studies for 30 minutes each day
contradictions.b: User studies for 2 hours every day

provenance_checks.fact_hint: User daily study time is 2 hours
